_doc: Value semantics per block, deduced from the UCMake Arduino library (the upload path compiles against it, so these are exact there) plus the block menus. Realtime replies are INFERRED from the same maths and want one hardware confirmation each. 'verified' is the honest state: 'hardware' = confirmed on a real board, 'inferred' = deduced, 'unknown' = no library class exists.
